photo.description: Coral reefs are among the world's richest ecosystems, second only to tropical rain forests in plant and animal diversity. They are also extremely sensitive environments that have special temperature, salinity, light, oxygen, and nutrient needs. If environmental conditions shift or worsen from pollution or other disruption, the health of a coral reef ecosystem can suffer.
